{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "moral",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish mid-invocation, redirecting her First Sacrifice to Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call for the cost to be named aloud—exposing the wound in front of everyone.",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_actor_id": "named:seren",
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-sentence, her fingers tightening around the ceremonial sash she’s supposed to be holding as she glances at Lirael instead of the assembled First Favored.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s muffled cry behind the mouthband draws every eye, but Seren’s gaze locks onto her, unblinking.",
      "The presiding Dohkar’s posture shifts—his fingers tap once against the spiralgrass, a signal to pause."
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Let Seren name the wound aloud and risk the rite twisting, or tear off the mouthband and speak for her—breaking protocol in front of witnesses?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_element_ids": ["O1", "O4", "O6"],
    "environment_realizations": {
      "O1": "The weeping-willow veil-canopy sways unevenly, some strands frayed where Seren’s fingers brushed them in rehearsal.",
      "O4": "The mouthband is damp with Lirael’s breath, the silk fraying at the edges from her teeth."
    },
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — her ward, the girl who trained with her for months, her hands trembling now though she’s never shown fear before, her voice already softening the words she was supposed to speak plainly.",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "Lirael’s fingers twitch toward the mouthband, then stop—she’s always torn it off when the pressure got too much, but this time, she lets it stay.",
    "scene_want": "Wants Seren to finish the wish without naming the wound, but knows the Dohkar will demand it.",
    "scene_mission": "Stop the wish from twisting before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be named aloud.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is mid-sacrifice, the presiding Dohkar is about to demand the cost, and Lirael is the only one who can halt it—but she’s bound by protocol.",
      "believes": "The wound Seren is hiding will be exposed if the rite continues, and the First Favored will see it.",
      "wondering": "What will Lirael choose—protocol or protection?",
      "must_not_confuse": "The mouthband is only protocol, not a spell; Seren’s sacrifice is the only thing that can twist the wish."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the mouthband’s frayed edges)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (Julian’s gaze lingers on Seren’s hands, the only part of her that hasn’t stopped moving)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_OPENING_BEAT" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONCEAL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s fingers brush the ceremonial sash she’s supposed to be holding, then drop it—her hands are too busy smoothing the air between her and Lirael, as if she could blur the wound with her breath.",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E4",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of direct naming reveals her belief that softening the wound is kinder than making it plain.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes hiding the wound protects Lirael, but the Dohkar will force it out."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s fingers tap once against the spiralgrass—his signal to pause—but his eyes stay fixed on Seren’s hands, not her words.",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E6",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O3"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "His focus on the hands, not the words, shows he judges the offering by precision, not compassion.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar assumes his judgment carries authority, and he’ll demand the cost be named."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target_object_id": "O4",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "The mouthband’s silk is frayed where Lirael’s teeth have caught it, the edges damp with her breath."
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her hesitation to tear off the mouthband reveals she’s already calculating the cost of breaking protocol.",
      "beat": "Lirael’s fingers hover over the mouthband, then still—she’s always torn it off when the pressure got too much, but this time, she lets it stay, her breath muffled against the silk."
    }
  }
}
